summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary pricing supplement (424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) for a registered offering of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes linked to equity indices. The notes are senior unsecured obligations with $1,000 stated principal, issued as part of the Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program. Terms include monthly contingent coupons and automatic call feature. This is a routine structured note takedown under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation event.
